exposure: Number of previous cesarean sections (categorized as lower order: 3 or less, and higher order: 4 or more)
cohort: 100 pregnant females with at least one previous cesarean section undergoing elective or emergency cesarean sections.
finding: Higher order cesarean sections were associated with significantly increased risks of dense adhesions, placenta previa, and bladder injury compared to lower order cesarean sections.
mod_finding: Repeated cesarean sections, particularly those of higher order (four or more), significantly increase the risk of maternal complications.
cross-section timing: Data collected from July to December 2017
